summary: The reader is an undergraduate computer scientist: asymptotic analysis, algorithm design basics (divide and conquer, recurrences, schoolbook and Karatsuba multiplication), discrete mathematics (modular arithmetic, primes, induction, permutations), and linear algebra and calculus at the usual first-course level. They know polynomials, complex numbers with roots of unity, and simple Turing machines with tapes. They have not studied the FFT in depth, Fourier analysis on groups, tensor products, numerical analysis, or fast integer multiplication research.

known.name: Logarithms and iterated logarithm notation
known.gloss: The base-2 logarithm lg n, its rules, and the fact that powers of lg n grow slower than any power of n.

known.name: Floor, ceiling and rounding
known.gloss: Rounding a real number down, up or to the nearest integer.

known.name: Binary representation and bit operations
known.gloss: Integers written in base 2 as bit strings, with bitwise operations such as XOR and extraction of bit ranges.

known.name: Radix (base-b) expansion
known.gloss: Writing an integer as a sum of digits times powers of a base, so that multiplying integers becomes multiplying digit polynomials followed by carrying.

known.name: Schoolbook multiplication and carries
known.gloss: The quadratic digit-by-digit multiplication algorithm, with carries propagated from low to high digits.

known.name: Divide and conquer recurrences
known.gloss: Bounding the cost of a recursive algorithm by solving a recurrence, as in Karatsuba multiplication.

known.name: Modular arithmetic and congruences
known.gloss: Arithmetic on integers modulo N, including residues, congruences and the cyclic group of residues.

known.name: Prime numbers and coprimality
known.gloss: Primes, greatest common divisors and the notion of pairwise coprime integers.

known.name: Permutations and bijections
known.gloss: A bijection of a finite set onto itself or another set, used to reorder array entries.

known.name: Vectors, matrices and linear maps
known.gloss: Finite-dimensional vector spaces over the reals or complexes, linear maps as matrices, and invertibility.

known.name: Subspaces, dimension and rank
known.gloss: Subspaces of a vector space, their dimension, and the rank of a linear map.

known.name: Vector spaces over GF(2)
known.gloss: Linear algebra with bits as scalars, where addition is XOR.

known.name: Triangular matrices and elimination
known.gloss: Matrices with zeros above or below the diagonal, and factoring a matrix into triangular pieces.

known.name: Norms and triangle inequality
known.gloss: Size of numbers and vectors, with the triangle inequality used to bound sums of errors.

known.name: Exponential function and Euler's formula
known.gloss: The exponential function, e^{ix}=cos x + i sin x, and the Gaussian e^{-x^2} as a decaying function.

known.name: Fixed-point and finite-precision numbers
known.gloss: Numbers stored with a fixed number of binary digits after the point, with rounding errors.

known.name: Direct sum and product of index sets
known.gloss: Indexing an array by tuples from a Cartesian product of sets and flattening it to a linear order.

known.name: Deterministic algorithms and upper/lower bounds
known.gloss: An algorithm without randomness, with worst-case running time, and what it means for a bound to be optimal.

known.name: Induction and proofs by recursion
known.gloss: Proving statements by induction and analysing recursive procedures.

known.name: Constants, exponents and power-of-two sizes
aliases: padding to a power of two
known.gloss: Sizes chosen as powers of two and padding inputs up to them.
